use axum::{extract::Extension, Json, Router, routing::get};

#[derive(Clone)]
struct HeavyState {
    large_data: Vec<u8>,
    cache: std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
}

// BAD: Extension clones HeavyState per request - large_data Vec is fully cloned each time
async fn handler(Extension(state): Extension<HeavyState>) -> Json<serde_json::Value> {
    Json(serde_json::json!({ "len": state.large_data.len() }))
}

fn app() -> Router {
    let state = HeavyState {
        large_data: vec![0u8; 10_000_000],
        cache: Default::default(),
    };
    Router::new()
        .route("/", get(handler))
        .layer(Extension(state))
}
